paragraphs: The “Product Add-Ons” category is a top-level department in Shopify’s product taxonomy. It brings together the product families assigned to Product Add-Ons, providing the starting point for classification throughout this branch of the catalog. Its immediate branches include Extended Warranties, Installation Services, Maintenance Plans, Product Customization, Product Upgrades and additional specialized categories.

Choose Product Add-Ons when the product’s primary purpose fits this classification path. Compare its position with adjacent categories under Product Add-Ons before assigning a product, using the product’s actual function rather than a promotional name. Where an immediate branch describes the product more precisely, follow that branch and continue to the most appropriate specific category.

The “Extended Warranties” category belongs to Product Add-Ons. It groups items under the official Shopify classification “Product Add-Ons > Extended Warranties”, keeping this product family distinct within its parent, Product Add-Ons. This is a terminal category in this release, so it provides the most specific available placement along this classification path.
